hero.title: Day Delegate Packages
hero.lede: For meetings, training days and small conferences we set up the function suite the way you need it, keep the tea and coffee coming and serve a working lunch from our own kitchen. We quote per event, so tell us your numbers.

sections.title: A meeting or training day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
A good day delegate package is mostly about not having to think. The room is ready when you arrive, set out the way you asked for; the tea and coffee appear at the right moments; lunch is on time and nobody has to leave the building for it; and at the end of the day you pack up and go. That is what we aim for.

Our Back o’ Barns function suite takes up to 120 theatre-style and around 100 at tables, and it is air-conditioned, which matters more than you’d think on a long training day. Tell us the layout you want, whether theatre, classroom, boardroom or a U of tables, and how many are coming, and we’ll have it set before you arrive. Tell us too what equipment you’re bringing or need, and we’ll say what we have and what we can arrange. The hotel has free WiFi.

Refreshments come from our own kitchen: tea and coffee on arrival and at the breaks, and a working lunch served in the room or in the restaurant, whichever keeps your day moving. If your delegates are travelling from a distance, the hotel has 18 en-suite rooms, with a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order when it is part of the rate. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, with the fastest trains reaching Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes, and junction 6 of the M74 is close by, with free parking when you get here.

We quote per event rather than publishing a single day delegate rate, because the price depends on your numbers, how long you need the room and what you’d like to eat. Send us the date, the layout and a head count and we’ll come back with a figure.

sections.title: Meetings and training days: what people ask us

items.q: How do you price a day delegate package?
items.a: We quote per event. Send us the date, your numbers, the layout you want and whether you need a working lunch or just refreshments, and we’ll come back with a figure for the day. Catering menus are confirmed each season.

items.q: What layouts can you set up?
items.a: Theatre-style for up to 120, or classroom, boardroom and U-shaped layouts for smaller numbers, up to around 100 at tables. Tell us what you need and we’ll have the room set before you arrive.
Tell us what you are bringing and what you need, from a screen to a flip chart, and we’ll say what we have on site and what we can arrange. The hotel has free WiFi.

Yes. We have 18 en-suite rooms in the hotel, in single, twin and double sizes, so colleagues can have a room each. Check-in is from 2pm and check-out by 11am, and a full Scottish breakfast is cooked to order when it is part of the rate. Ask about rooms when you book the meeting and we’ll hold them alongside it.
